scope: Ordinary Legends rules and flavor only. The candidate is not a runtime default or a whole-card compliance score.
method: 36 training cards; one shared profile frozen before scoring 36 reserved cards. Fixed frame-only normalized scans. Actual painter layers, replay parity checked; second full run reproduces all 72 scores exactly.

classification.large: At most 135 printed characters and five measured lines; mixed rules/flavor and keyword headings retain left rules where applicable.
classification.dense: Over 260 printed characters. REJECTED as a general rule: Hazezon Tamar and Angus Mackenzie demonstrate that length alone does not select the printed face.

review.name: Hazezon Tamar
review.issue: Incorrect small-face classification; printed discretionary hyphenation is also unsupported.

review.name: Angus Mackenzie
review.issue: Incorrect regular-face classification despite a shorter passage.

review.name: Fallen Angel
review.issue: Mixed alignment within a paragraph and different line breaks.

review.name: Rasputin Dreamweaver
review.issue: Vertical placement and remaining tiny-face wrapping need review.

review.name: Cosmic Horror
review.issue: Training example uses the small face despite falling below the length cutoff.

next: Expand the original-text audit and font-style training cohort; freeze a new rule and evaluate fresh reserved cards before adopting typography. Keep artist/legal and power/toughness independent.

normalizationReview.note: Original measurements preserved. Corrected frame, color, title/type/symbol rechecks and fresh text validation are reported separately, including retained regressions.
